gloss: to listen carefully; to strain one's ears

definitions.gloss: to listen carefully; to strain one's ears
definitions.explanation: To concentrate intently on hearing a sound, often in a quiet environment.

examples.english: To strain one's ears to listen.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物音|ものおと}→物音：03633_monooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{澄|す}ました。
examples.english: I listened carefully to the distant sounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{殺|ころ}して→殺す：01944_korosu⟧{聞|き}き{澄|す}ます⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: When I held my breath and listened carefully in the forest at night, I could hear the faint sounds of insects.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen) + ⟦{澄|す}ます→澄ます：16578_sumasu⟧ (to make clear/pure). The idea is that by concentrating, one clears away distractions to hear more purely. Often appears in literary or narrative writing to describe a character focusing their hearing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{澄|す}ます: to prick up one's ears
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧{聞|き}き{澄|す}ます: to listen intently, motionlessly
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{殺|ころ}して→殺す：01944_korosu⟧{聞|き}き{澄|す}ます: to hold one's breath and listen carefully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耳|みみ}を{澄|す}ます→耳を澄ます：22673_mimiwosumasu⟧: to listen carefully — very similar meaning; this shorter form is more common in everyday speech
- {聞|き}き{入|い}る: to listen intently, to be absorbed in listening — emphasizes becoming engrossed
- ⟦{傾聴|けいちょう}→傾聴：19024_keichou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to listen attentively — formal; often used in counseling or business contexts
